title: Report sent
speaker: Biosphere Report
text: Biosphere Report sent. High for the third sol running. The acknowledgement carries back a header field we always leave empty. It isn't empty now.
notes: The lead mechanism (STORY.md §12: the Clause wakes when our report beats the others' for long enough). A chain: each step waits a sol (360 s) after the last and needs planet health ≥ 60 at home. +1 lead each.
